scenario.topic: Choose the mural motif for the school playground wall

options.name: Nature and Wildlife Theme
options.upside: Promotes environmental awareness and connects children with nature.
options.concern: May require frequent touch-ups due to detailed elements exposed to weather.

options.name: Abstract Geometric Patterns
options.upside: Creates a vibrant, dynamic look that encourages creativity and interpretation.
options.concern: Might be less engaging for younger children who prefer recognizable images.

options.name: Local History and Culture
options.upside: Educates students about the community’s heritage and fosters local pride.
options.concern: Requires research and approval to accurately represent cultural elements.

options.name: Playful Cartoon Characters
options.upside: Engages younger children with fun, friendly imagery that encourages play.
options.concern: May not appeal as strongly to older students or adults.

shared_context: The school playground wall will be painted with a mural to enhance the environment and reflect community values. Seven participants will decide on one of four mural motifs, each suitable for the outdoor wall and appealing to diverse age groups.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a middle school art teacher passionate about environmental education.
personas.private_goal: To choose a mural that inspires children to appreciate and protect nature.

A.reason_for: Promotes environmental awareness and connects children with nature, aligning with my teaching values.

B.reason_for: Modern abstract style could encourage creativity in older students.
B.reason_against: Less engaging for younger children who prefer recognizable images.

C.reason_for: Educates students about local heritage, fostering community pride.
C.reason_against: Needs careful research and approval to ensure accuracy.

D.reason_for: Fun and friendly for younger children, encouraging play.
D.reason_against: May not appeal to older students or adults.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a parent volunteer focused on community involvement in school activities.
personas.private_goal: To select a mural that reflects shared community values and appeals broadly.

A.reason_for: Nature theme connects well with all ages and promotes environmental care.

B.reason_for: Vibrant and dynamic, encouraging creativity especially in older kids.
B.reason_against: Younger children might find it less relatable.

C.reason_for: Highlights local culture and history, building community pride.
C.reason_against: Requires effort to ensure cultural accuracy.

D.reason_for: Engages younger children with playful imagery.
D.reason_against: Less appealing to older children and adults.

personas.name: Zara
personas.background: Zara is a kindergarten teacher who values playful and imaginative environments.
personas.private_goal: To pick a mural that delights and engages the youngest children in the school.

A.reason_for: Nature scenes are calming and educational for all ages.
A.reason_against: Might be too detailed and less immediately fun for young kids.

B.reason_for: Modern abstract art is visually interesting.
B.reason_against: Too abstract and less engaging for young children.

C.reason_for: Cultural themes educate and foster pride.
C.reason_against: May not capture young children’s attention as well.

D.reason_for: Bright, playful cartoon characters are perfect for engaging young children.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a youth counselor who works closely with elementary and middle school students.
personas.private_goal: To choose a mural that supports a positive and playful atmosphere for younger kids.

A.reason_for: Nature theme is inclusive and calming for all ages.

B.reason_for: Abstract patterns are visually stimulating for older children.

C.reason_against: May not be as engaging for younger kids.

D.reason_for: Playful cartoon characters encourage fun and engagement among younger children.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is a local historian and community liaison invested in cultural education.
personas.private_goal: To select a mural that accurately represents and celebrates local heritage.

A.reason_for: Nature theme is broadly appealing and promotes awareness.

B.reason_against: May not reflect community values clearly.

C.reason_for: Educates students about community heritage and fosters pride.

D.reason_against: Less relevant to cultural education and older students.

personas.name: Omar
personas.background: Omar is a passionate environmental activist and community organizer.
personas.private_goal: To inspire environmental stewardship through the mural design.

A.reason_for: Nature and wildlife theme promotes environmental awareness strongly.

B.reason_for: Abstract patterns encourage creativity and modern expression.

C.reason_for: Local history fosters community pride alongside environmental values.
C.reason_against: Needs approval to ensure respectful representation.

D.reason_for: Engages younger children with playful imagery.

personas.name: Tia
personas.background: Tia is a quiet librarian who values education and community stories.
personas.private_goal: To support a mural that educates and connects students to their community.

A.reason_for: Nature theme is educational and appealing to all ages.
A.reason_against: Could require upkeep due to detailed design.

B.reason_for: Abstract patterns are modern and creative.

C.reason_for: Local history and culture mural educates and fosters community pride.

D.reason_for: Playful characters are fun for young children.
